reviewScope.summary: Integrate the four owner-authorized teaching candidates, reconcile shared source and retain all existing release gates.
evidence: Compared the complete Git trees of common master 59ecbb77 and PRs #119, #117, #116 and #115: 61 distinct changed paths, four shared paths. Verified every unique path and unchanged base path by Git blob identity. Reconciled the module-specific lesson surface, combined E2E tests, offline manifest and current-state entry.

Git & GitHub, M02 and Utviklerblikk standalone candidates passed their hosted release and pilot checks; M01 latest red run identified an incorrect feedback assertion and a formatting issue on that line. Restored the actual wrong-choice feedback assertion without changing XP or persistence expectations. New M01 and combined runs are required.

Existing source-bound presentation logic and exercise grading/storage contracts retained. M01 and M02 assets loaded only for their respective modules. No dependencies, database, CSP, release workflow or budget changes. Original branch reviews retained as historical records; this new binding names the integrated payload.

Standalone JS gzip measurements: Git 476868 B, Utviklerblikk 477859 B, M02 482716 B. Standalone curriculum measurements: 266062, 265876 and 271951 B respectively. These cannot establish combined compliance. Run the existing budget and all regression gates on this tree.

adversarialFindings.description: M01 and M02 each modified the shared LessonView; taking either file alone would discard the other module's presentation.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Explicit module selection for visual data, preserve M01 editorial context and M02 copy layer, preserve both browser journeys and exact lesson anchor matching.

adversarialFindings.description: Replacing offline manifest with a single branch could omit content-addressed assets or reference superseded Git curriculum files.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use the Git-upgraded manifest plus both new Campaign presentation paths, preserving every other entry and sorting the union.

adversarialFindings.description: Combined JS and curriculum sizes may exceed the independent hard caps even though three branches passed separately.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Only proceed to hosted validation; the unchanged hard gate must measure and pass both budgets. No acceptance of a budget overrun or automatic threshold change.

adversarialFindings.description: Original M01 and Utviklerblikk full-area editorial and external-authoring scope is not completely reviewed.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Keep the implemented presentation upgrade scoped; preserve canonical assets and original review limitations. Do not claim a full editorial audit or source regeneration. Any concrete material concern must be resolved before production.

retrospective.summary: Proceed to native hosted validation of this combined development candidate only. No production readiness or full editorial completion claimed.
